main.title: Hi, I'm Mathieu
main.subtitle: Frontend developer
main.text: Passionate about web development and driven by a curious mind, I combine creativity and technical expertise to bring custom digital projects to life. With solid experience in Vue.js, WordPress, Elementor Pro, Nuxt.js, and CSS, I transform Figma mockups into dynamic and intuitive websites. Always ready to take on new challenges, I am now seeking to invest myself in a career that blends action, adventure, and meaningful impact.
